commit.message:
🔒 Fixed SQL injection in Content API slug filter ordering

ref https://linear.app/ghost/issue/ONC-1475

Switched to parameterized query bindings in the slug filter ordering
logic so user input is never interpolated into SQL strings. Updated
the crud plugin to thread bindings through when autoOrder returns a
{sql, bindings} object, and bumped @tryghost/bookshelf-plugins to
0.6.29 which adds parameterized orderByRaw support.

Reported-by: Nicholas Carlini <nicholas@carlini.com>
